- There is a dot of another color outside the box, lined up with the opening (either along row or column).
- The dot shoots a ray towards the opening, passing through the opening, entering the interior of the box, and stopping at the opposite inside wall (or edge) of the box!
- In example 1:
  - Box of 4s, opening at (2, 5).

  - Ray goes down along col 5: from (0, 5) down to (8, 5), stopping just before the bottom wall at (9, 5).
- In example 2:
  - Box of 8s, opening at (5, 4).
  - Dot of 2 at (5, 0).
  - Ray goes right along row 5: from (5, 0) to (5, 9), stopping before the right wall at (5, 10).
- In example 3:
  - Box of 6s, opening at (5, 3). Dot 7 at (7, 3). Ray goes up from (7, 3) to (2, 3), stopping before row 1 (6,6,6,6,6).
  - Box of 5s, opening at (10, 12). Dot 7 at (10, 13). Ray goes left from (10, 13) to (10, 9), stopping before col 8 (5,5,5,...).
